scripts.dev: npm run frontend 2>&1 | sed $'s/^/\e[33m[frontend]\e[0m /' & npm run backend 2>&1 | sed $'s/^/\e[36m[backend]\e[0m /' & npm run proxy 2>&1 | sed $'s/^/\e[32m[proxy]\e[0m /'
